wacc_build.tax_basis: 20% normalized judgment retained from pro-forma; not FY2026 effective rate.

limitations: WACC build uses September 15 Treasury 5.00%, September 1 ERP 4.14%, and judgment beta 1.75 / debt cost 5.5% / tax 20%; beta is not a regression estimate. Rounded base WACC is 11.8%.
June 30 cash, debt and NCI and August 10 common shares are proxies at September 15; no actual interim balance sheet is asserted.
Actual common shares are used, not historical diluted EPS weighted-average shares. SBC is retained as an economic expense without a cash add-back or forecast share issuance.
FY2027 DCF uses a 288/365 remaining-year fraction under uniform cash generation; annual statements still show the full fiscal year. Seasonality and interim actual cash flows are not modeled.
Terminal reinvestment changes to g times closing modeled operating capital; this transition is an assumption, not company guidance.
Financing failures are shown separately from operating value: conditional DCF diagnostics do not make an unfunded scenario executable.
No new acquisitions, divestitures, refinancing, NCI earnings/distributions or incremental capacity constraints beyond the inherited lab conventions.
Debt maturity table conflicts with some narrative maturity dates; annual funding results follow the table and are conditional. Springing maturities, intrayear timing and covenants are not modeled.

The August 2026 ~$945m subsidiary facility was known before the cutoff but is excluded from parent funding capacity because its uses/guarantees are restricted. Funding failures are not company insolvency forecasts.

Gross debt and NCI book value proxy market claims; finance leases and $49m pension deficits are deducted separately. Operating lease costs remain expenses; strategic equity assets receive no separate value without a verified realizable amount.

scenarios.name: Low: demand slowdown with investment restraint
scenarios.cause: Slower AI orders/pricing pressure reduce growth and margin; management lowers capex intensity 1 pp. This funding response is necessary to the coherent low case, not guaranteed. The sticky-capex stress is preserved separately.

scenarios.name: Base: growth fades and manufacturing improves
scenarios.cause: Original growth/margin/reinvestment forecast retained; dated, judgment-dependent WACC replaces the placeholder.

scenarios.name: High: stronger demand plus execution and cash discipline
scenarios.cause: Demand growth and product mix improve; better utilization reduces capex intensity 0.5 pp and ending inventory days by 15. This case requires efficient use of installed capacity; it is not growth without reinvestment.

scenarios.name: Stress: slowdown with sticky investment (not executable)
scenarios.cause: Growth and margin disappoint while committed capacity spending stays high. Retained to expose financing shortfalls; not included in the passing-case valuation range.

peers.policy: Existing prior policy retained: more than one continent; >=50% annual datacenter/communications sales without double counting; market cap >=$5bn. Optical manufacturing/capital intensity are supporting characteristics.
peers.policy_check: FN multi-continent operations, 81.2% qualifying revenue and ~$13.43bn market cap using June shares support admission. Exact September 15 share count remains a timing limitation. LITE annual qualifying mix remains unverified; do not call it a verified policy pass.
peers.cash_policy: Retain 4.21455987% of annual sales for both companies; exclude operating leases from debt because lease costs remain operating expenses.
limitations: FN contract manufacturing differs from COHR product ownership, R&D and margins; one peer does not establish a diversified range.
Annual reported GAAP earnings; not forward or adjusted EPS. COHR includes unusual items; P/E is a qualified cross-check.
EBITDA = reported operating EBIT + reported D&A; SBC retained. Market-cap shares are dated actual shares; EPS shares are annual diluted averages by definition.
Zero FN finance lease/pension/NCI claims follows disclosed balance-sheet scope; no separate strategic equity-investment value is added for either company.
Prices retained from prior research; September 15 historical rows corroborated during final preparation. Mixed market/financial dates are disclosed.
No transaction multiple adopted: company divestitures/control transactions lack a sufficiently comparable target-wide denominator and synergy/timing adjustment.
